prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Preset fast-track adoption flows, photo quality callouts, interactive progress carousels, and split-view path selection screens were helpful.
Spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, post-adoption certificate sign-in placement, and desktop diagnostic flows showed no clear effect.
Path decision speed helper callouts performed worse than the control.
Predictions were too low for visual callouts, interactive progress carousels, and split-view path selection screens.
Predictions were too high for flow restructuring, sign-in reordering, non-significant tests, and changes that worsened performance.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +10.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +9.3% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +7.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: +6.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -1.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +7.8% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.3% over 2 test(s)

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Playful Pet Interaction Starter Hub: Redesign the final welcome screen into a centered interactive card featuring quick-start action buttons and mascot guide for basic pet controls. (why: The finish step has a 64.8% completion rate with long mean duration (5815s), and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Style Selector View: Insert a dedicated pet style choice screen prior to photo uploading to select artistic visual filters and pet archetypes. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failure or wrong visual output, and adoption conversion drops to 70.9%.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Persona Guided Companion Path Flow: Introduce an interactive quiz flow screen before path selection to recommend either a quick preset pet or custom creation based on user preferences. (why: Path selection has a high mean duration (514s), indicating user decision hesitation when choosing an adoption path.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Carousel Choice Card Path Layout: Switch path choice layout to an interactive horizontal card carousel displaying pet capabilities. (why: Path selection has 82.0% conversion and long mean time (514s); interactive carousels previously proved effective.)
4: [adoption, copy] Custom Pet Generation Guidelines Copy: Update upload photos screen headline and hint text with clear formatting instructions for best image generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.)
5: [finish, notification] First Desktop Interaction Callout Banner: Add an interactive callout banner on final intro screen demonstrating key combination shortcuts and menu access. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with pets.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Pet Adoption Naming Ceremony Badge: Add a celebratory certificate badge and name input accent on adoption certificate to enhance emotional attachment. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 70.9% and takes median 89s / mean 1017s.)
